format_python_code_blocks_in_mdx: format all python code blocks in an MDX file using Black with a 90 character line length
check_code_formatting_in_mdx: check if python code blocks in an MDX file are properly formatted without modifying the file
batch_format_chapter_files: format all MDX files in the chapters directory by running Black on embedded python code blocks
check_all_chapters_formatting: check all MDX files in the chapters directory for formatting issues and raise an error if any need formatting
run_code_formatter_cli: run the code formatter CLI with the --check_only flag to validate formatting across all chapter files
